segments.he: פעם אחד נסע הבעש"ט ז"ל דרך עיר אומן וסבבו אותו מחנות מחנות יונים והוא עמד את עצמו אצלם ואמר להם אני לא אוכל להשאיר אצלכם לתקן אתכם רק נכדי הוא יתקן אתכם וסבב להם בידיו שיכלו ממנו ופרחו ממנו. וכן מצאו פעם אחד קמיע של הרה"צ ר' נפתלי כ"ץ ז"ל שהי' כתוב שם לך ליער גרעקוב אצל עיר אומן ושם תמצא תיקונך".
segments.en: When Rabbainu was young and fasting from Shabbos to Shabbos, once midweek [on the night of Tuesday or Wednesday] he became very weak and blood poured greatly from his nostrils and mouth — he was in mortal danger. Reb Chaykel [Rabbainu's cantor] begged him to break his fast until Rabbainu was compelled to agree. Reb Chaykel went immediately, took a fowl, went to have it slaughtered — and right on the way back plucked all the feathers on the road so it would be ready quickly. He prepared it, cooked it, and brought the broth before Rabbainu. Rabbainu was already holding the vessel for the handwashing — and while still holding it said to Reb Chaykel: "Please sing Meyin Olam Haba." And Reb Chaykel sang — and Rabbainu became absorbed in this and forgot about eating. Each time Reb Chaykel finished, Rabbainu said: "Sing Meyin Olam Haba once more." And so it was the entire night until morning dawned and it was time for the morning Shema — and Rabbainu did not break his fast until the following Shabbos night, as always.
